<p>Below we focus on the general setup and provider instance creation. You can also <a class="font-normal text-gray-1000! underline decoration-1 decoration-gray-700 underline-offset-4 hover:text-gray-1000! hover:decoration-gray-1000 hover:opacity-100!" href="/providers/openai-compatible-providers/custom-providers">write a custom provider package leveraging the OpenAI Compatible package</a>.</p>
<p>We provide detailed documentation for the following OpenAI compatible providers:</p>
<ul>
<li><a class="font-normal text-gray-1000! underline decoration-1 decoration-gray-700 underline-offset-4 hover:text-gray-1000! hover:decoration-gray-1000 hover:opacity-100!" href="/providers/openai-compatible-providers/lmstudio">LM Studio</a></li>
<li><a class="font-normal text-gray-1000! underline decoration-1 decoration-gray-700 underline-offset-4 hover:text-gray-1000! hover:decoration-gray-1000 hover:opacity-100!" href="/providers/openai-compatible-providers/nim">NIM</a></li>
<li><a class="font-normal text-gray-1000! underline decoration-1 decoration-gray-700 underline-offset-4 hover:text-gray-1000! hover:decoration-gray-1000 hover:opacity-100!" href="/providers/openai-compatible-providers/modelrush">ModelRush</a></li>
<li><a class="font-normal text-gray-1000! underline decoration-1 decoration-gray-700 underline-offset-4 hover:text-gray-1000! hover:decoration-gray-1000 hover:opacity-100!" href="/providers/openai-compatible-providers/cheaper-inference">Cheaper Inference</a></li>
<li><a class="font-normal text-gray-1000! underline decoration-1 decoration-gray-700 underline-offset-4 hover:text-gray-1000! hover:decoration-gray-1000 hover:opacity-100!" href="/providers/openai-compatible-providers/heroku">Heroku</a></li>
<li><a class="font-normal text-gray-1000! underline decoration-1 decoration-gray-700 underline-offset-4 hover:text-gray-1000! hover:decoration-gray-1000 hover:opacity-100!" href="/providers/openai-compatible-providers/clarifai">Clarifai</a></li>
<li><a class="font-normal text-gray-1000! underline decoration-1 decoration-gray-700 underline-offset-4 hover:text-gray-1000! hover:decoration-gray-1000 hover:opacity-100!" href="/providers/openai-compatible-providers/nearai">NEAR AI Cloud</a></li>
</ul>
<p>The general setup and provider instance creation is the same for all of these providers.</p>

<p>You can use the following optional settings to customize the provider instance:</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong>baseURL</strong> <em>string</em></p>
<p>Set the URL prefix for API calls.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>apiKey</strong> <em>string</em></p>
<p>API key for authenticating requests. If specified, adds an <code>Authorization</code>
header to request headers with the value <code>Bearer &lt;apiKey&gt;</code>. This will be added
before any headers potentially specified in the <code>headers</code> option.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>headers</strong> <em>Record&lt;string,string&gt;</em></p>
<p>Optional custom headers to include in requests. These will be added to request headers
after any headers potentially added by use of the <code>apiKey</code> option.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>queryParams</strong> <em>Record&lt;string,string&gt;</em></p>
<p>Optional custom url query parameters to include in request urls.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>fetch</strong> <em>(input: RequestInfo, init?: RequestInit) =&gt; Promise&lt;Response&gt;</em></p>
<p>Custom <a href="https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/fetch" rel="noreferrer noopener" target="_blank" class="font-normal text-gray-1000! underline decoration-1 decoration-gray-700 underline-offset-4 hover:text-gray-1000! hover:decoration-gray-1000 hover:opacity-100!">fetch</a> implementation.
Defaults to the global <code>fetch</code> function.
You can use it as a middleware to intercept requests,
or to provide a custom fetch implementation for e.g. testing.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>includeUsage</strong> <em>boolean</em></p>
<p>Include usage information in streaming responses. When enabled, usage data will be included in the response metadata for streaming requests. Defaults to <code>undefined</code> (<code>false</code>).</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>supportsStructuredOutputs</strong> <em>boolean</em></p>
<p>Set to true if the provider supports structured outputs. Only relevant for <code>provider()</code>, <code>provider.chatModel()</code>, and <code>provider.languageModel()</code>.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>supportsMultiPartToolContent</strong> <em>boolean</em></p>
<p>Set to true if the provider supports multi-part content arrays in tool
results. When enabled, tool outputs with <code>type: &#x27;content&#x27;</code> can contain text,
images, video, audio, and PDF content parts. Defaults to <code>false</code>. Only
relevant for <code>provider()</code>, <code>provider.chatModel()</code>, and
<code>provider.languageModel()</code>.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>supportedUrls</strong> <em>() =&gt; Record&lt;string, RegExp[]&gt;</em></p>
<p>Defines URLs that chat models can access directly, grouped by media type.
Matching URLs are passed to the provider instead of being downloaded by the
AI SDK.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>transformRequestBody</strong> <em>(args: Record&lt;string, any&gt;) =&gt; Record&lt;string, any&gt;</em></p>
<p>Optional function to transform the request body before sending it to the API.
This is useful for proxy providers that may require a different request format
than the official OpenAI API.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>metadataExtractor</strong> <em>MetadataExtractor</em></p>
<p>Optional metadata extractor to capture provider-specific metadata from API responses.
See <a class="font-normal text-gray-1000! underline decoration-1 decoration-gray-700 underline-offset-4 hover:text-gray-1000! hover:decoration-gray-1000 hover:opacity-100!" href="#custom-metadata-extraction">Custom Metadata Extraction</a> for details.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<h2 class="flex scroll-m-28 flex-row items-center gap-2" id="language-models"><a class="peer" data-card="" href="#language-models">Language Models</a><svg data-slot="geist-icon" height="16" style="color:var(--ds-gray-900)" viewBox="0 0 16 16" width="16" aria-hidden="true" class="size-3.5 shrink-0 opacity-0 transition-opacity peer-hover:opacity-100"><path clip-rule="evenodd" d="M8.47 1.47a4.29 4.29 0 1 1 6.06 6.06l-2.5 2.5-1.06-1.06 2.5-2.5a2.79 2.79 0 0 0-3.94-3.94l-2.5 2.5-1.06-1.06zm3.06 4.06-6 6-1.06-1.06 6-6zm-10.06 9a4.3 4.3 0 0 0 6.06 0l2.5-2.5-1.06-1.06-2.5 2.5a2.79 2.79 0 0 1-3.94-3.94l2.5-2.5-1.06-1.06-2.5 2.5a4.3 4.3 0 0 0 0 6.06" fill="currentColor" fill-rule="evenodd"></path></svg></h2>
<p>You can create provider models using a provider instance.
The first argument is the model id, e.g. <code>model-id</code>.</p>

<p>You can also use the following factory methods:</p>
<ul>
<li><code>provider.languageModel(&#x27;model-id&#x27;)</code> - creates a chat language model (same as <code>provider(&#x27;model-id&#x27;)</code>)</li>
<li><code>provider.chatModel(&#x27;model-id&#x27;)</code> - creates a chat language model</li>
</ul>
<h3 class="flex scroll-m-28 flex-row items-center gap-2" id="supported-capabilities"><a class="peer" data-card="" href="#supported-capabilities">Supported Capabilities</a><svg data-slot="geist-icon" height="16" style="color:var(--ds-gray-900)" viewBox="0 0 16 16" width="16" aria-hidden="true" class="size-3.5 shrink-0 opacity-0 transition-opacity peer-hover:opacity-100"><path clip-rule="evenodd" d="M8.47 1.47a4.29 4.29 0 1 1 6.06 6.06l-2.5 2.5-1.06-1.06 2.5-2.5a2.79 2.79 0 0 0-3.94-3.94l-2.5 2.5-1.06-1.06zm3.06 4.06-6 6-1.06-1.06 6-6zm-10.06 9a4.3 4.3 0 0 0 6.06 0l2.5-2.5-1.06-1.06-2.5 2.5a2.79 2.79 0 0 1-3.94-3.94l2.5-2.5-1.06-1.06-2.5 2.5a4.3 4.3 0 0 0 0 6.06" fill="currentColor" fill-rule="evenodd"></path></svg></h3>
<p>Chat models created with this provider support the following capabilities:</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Text generation</strong> - Generate text completions</li>
<li><strong>Streaming</strong> - Stream text responses in real-time</li>
<li><strong>Tool calling</strong> - Call tools/functions with streaming support</li>
<li><strong>Structured outputs</strong> - Generate JSON with schema validation (when <code>supportsStructuredOutputs</code> is enabled)</li>
<li><strong>Reasoning content</strong> - Support for models that return reasoning/thinking tokens (e.g., DeepSeek R1)</li>
<li><strong>System messages</strong> - Support for system prompts</li>
<li><strong>Multi-modal inputs</strong> - Support for images and other content types (provider-dependent)</li>
</ul>
<p>Some providers extend the OpenAI Chat Completions API with multi-part tool
result content. You can opt into this behavior when creating the provider:</p>

<p>Only enable <code>supportsMultiPartToolContent</code> when the provider accepts content
arrays for messages with the <code>tool</code> role. The default stringifies multi-part
tool results for compatibility with the OpenAI Chat Completions API.</p>

<p><code>video_url</code> is an OpenAI-compatible provider extension, not an official OpenAI
Chat Completions content type. Video support, accepted formats, size and
duration limits, and support for public or data URLs depend on the provider and
model. Prefer hosted URLs when supported to avoid embedding large videos in

<h3 class="flex scroll-m-28 flex-row items-center gap-2" id="image-model-options"><a class="peer" data-card="" href="#image-model-options">Image Model Options</a><svg data-slot="geist-icon" height="16" style="color:var(--ds-gray-900)" viewBox="0 0 16 16" width="16" aria-hidden="true" class="size-3.5 shrink-0 opacity-0 transition-opacity peer-hover:opacity-100"><path clip-rule="evenodd" d="M8.47 1.47a4.29 4.29 0 1 1 6.06 6.06l-2.5 2.5-1.06-1.06 2.5-2.5a2.79 2.79 0 0 0-3.94-3.94l-2.5 2.5-1.06-1.06zm3.06 4.06-6 6-1.06-1.06 6-6zm-10.06 9a4.3 4.3 0 0 0 6.06 0l2.5-2.5-1.06-1.06-2.5 2.5a2.79 2.79 0 0 1-3.94-3.94l2.5-2.5-1.06-1.06-2.5 2.5a4.3 4.3 0 0 0 0 6.06" fill="currentColor" fill-rule="evenodd"></path></svg></h3>
<p>The following common provider options are available for image models:</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong>size</strong> <em>string</em></p>
<p>Dimensions of the generated image. Use the top-level <code>size</code> option for
standard dimensions, or this provider option for provider-specific values
such as <code>auto</code>.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>quality</strong> <em>string</em></p>
<p>Quality of the generated image. Supported values depend on the provider and
model.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>output_format</strong> <em>string</em></p>
<p>File format of the generated image.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>output_compression</strong> <em>number</em></p>
<p>Compression level from <code>0</code> to <code>100</code> for formats such as JPEG and WebP.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>background</strong> <em>string</em></p>
<p>Background behavior for the generated image. Supported values depend on the
provider and model.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p>Providers and models may support <code>auto</code> for <code>size</code>, <code>quality</code>, or <code>background</code>.</p>
<p><code>OpenAICompatibleImageModelOptions</code> also accepts additional provider-specific
options. These options are passed through to the provider API unchanged.</p>
<h3 class="flex scroll-m-28 flex-row items-center gap-2" id="image-editing"><a class="peer" data-card="" href="#image-editing">Image Editing</a><svg data-slot="geist-icon" height="16" style="color:var(--ds-gray-900)" viewBox="0 0 16 16" width="16" aria-hidden="true" class="size-3.5 shrink-0 opacity-0 transition-opacity peer-hover:opacity-100"><path clip-rule="evenodd" d="M8.47 1.47a4.29 4.29 0 1 1 6.06 6.06l-2.5 2.5-1.06-1.06 2.5-2.5a2.79 2.79 0 0 0-3.94-3.94l-2.5 2.5-1.06-1.06zm3.06 4.06-6 6-1.06-1.06 6-6zm-10.06 9a4.3 4.3 0 0 0 6.06 0l2.5-2.5-1.06-1.06-2.5 2.5a2.79 2.79 0 0 1-3.94-3.94l2.5-2.5-1.06-1.06-2.5 2.5a4.3 4.3 0 0 0 0 6.06" fill="currentColor" fill-rule="evenodd"></path></svg></h3>
<p>The OpenAI Compatible provider supports image editing through the <code>/images/edits</code> endpoint. Pass input images via <code>prompt.images</code> to transform or edit existing images.</p>

<h3 class="flex scroll-m-28 flex-row items-center gap-2" id="embedding-model-options"><a class="peer" data-card="" href="#embedding-model-options">Embedding Model Options</a><svg data-slot="geist-icon" height="16" style="color:var(--ds-gray-900)" viewBox="0 0 16 16" width="16" aria-hidden="true" class="size-3.5 shrink-0 opacity-0 transition-opacity peer-hover:opacity-100"><path clip-rule="evenodd" d="M8.47 1.47a4.29 4.29 0 1 1 6.06 6.06l-2.5 2.5-1.06-1.06 2.5-2.5a2.79 2.79 0 0 0-3.94-3.94l-2.5 2.5-1.06-1.06zm3.06 4.06-6 6-1.06-1.06 6-6zm-10.06 9a4.3 4.3 0 0 0 6.06 0l2.5-2.5-1.06-1.06-2.5 2.5a2.79 2.79 0 0 1-3.94-3.94l2.5-2.5-1.06-1.06-2.5 2.5a4.3 4.3 0 0 0 0 6.06" fill="currentColor" fill-rule="evenodd"></path></svg></h3>
<p>The following provider options are available for embedding models via <code>providerOptions</code>:</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong>dimensions</strong> <em>number</em></p>
<p>The number of dimensions the resulting output embeddings should have.
Only supported in models that allow dimension configuration.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>user</strong> <em>string</em></p>
<p>A unique identifier representing your end-user, which can help providers to
monitor and detect abuse.</p>
</li>
</ul>

<h3 class="flex scroll-m-28 flex-row items-center gap-2" id="completion-model-options"><a class="peer" data-card="" href="#completion-model-options">Completion Model Options</a><svg data-slot="geist-icon" height="16" style="color:var(--ds-gray-900)" viewBox="0 0 16 16" width="16" aria-hidden="true" class="size-3.5 shrink-0 opacity-0 transition-opacity peer-hover:opacity-100"><path clip-rule="evenodd" d="M8.47 1.47a4.29 4.29 0 1 1 6.06 6.06l-2.5 2.5-1.06-1.06 2.5-2.5a2.79 2.79 0 0 0-3.94-3.94l-2.5 2.5-1.06-1.06zm3.06 4.06-6 6-1.06-1.06 6-6zm-10.06 9a4.3 4.3 0 0 0 6.06 0l2.5-2.5-1.06-1.06-2.5 2.5a2.79 2.79 0 0 1-3.94-3.94l2.5-2.5-1.06-1.06-2.5 2.5a4.3 4.3 0 0 0 0 6.06" fill="currentColor" fill-rule="evenodd"></path></svg></h3>
<p>The following provider options are available for completion models via <code>providerOptions</code>:</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong>echo</strong> <em>boolean</em></p>
<p>Echo back the prompt in addition to the completion.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>logitBias</strong> <em>Record&lt;string, number&gt;</em></p>
<p>Modify the likelihood of specified tokens appearing in the completion.
Accepts a JSON object that maps tokens (specified by their token ID) to an
associated bias value from -100 to 100.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>suffix</strong> <em>string</em></p>
<p>The suffix that comes after a completion of inserted text.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>user</strong> <em>string</em></p>
<p>A unique identifier representing your end-user, which can help providers to
monitor and detect abuse.</p>
</li>
</ul>

<h2 class="flex scroll-m-28 flex-row items-center gap-2" id="chat-model-options"><a class="peer" data-card="" href="#chat-model-options">Chat Model Options</a><svg data-slot="geist-icon" height="16" style="color:var(--ds-gray-900)" viewBox="0 0 16 16" width="16" aria-hidden="true" class="size-3.5 shrink-0 opacity-0 transition-opacity peer-hover:opacity-100"><path clip-rule="evenodd" d="M8.47 1.47a4.29 4.29 0 1 1 6.06 6.06l-2.5 2.5-1.06-1.06 2.5-2.5a2.79 2.79 0 0 0-3.94-3.94l-2.5 2.5-1.06-1.06zm3.06 4.06-6 6-1.06-1.06 6-6zm-10.06 9a4.3 4.3 0 0 0 6.06 0l2.5-2.5-1.06-1.06-2.5 2.5a2.79 2.79 0 0 1-3.94-3.94l2.5-2.5-1.06-1.06-2.5 2.5a4.3 4.3 0 0 0 0 6.06" fill="currentColor" fill-rule="evenodd"></path></svg></h2>
<p>The following provider options are available for chat models via <code>providerOptions</code>:</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong>user</strong> <em>string</em></p>
<p>A unique identifier representing your end-user, which can help the provider to
monitor and detect abuse.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>reasoningEffort</strong> <em>string</em></p>
<p>Reasoning effort for reasoning models. The exact values depend on the provider.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>textVerbosity</strong> <em>string</em></p>
<p>Controls the verbosity of the generated text. The exact values depend on the provider.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>strictJsonSchema</strong> <em>boolean</em></p>
<p>Whether to use strict JSON schema validation. When true, the model uses constrained
decoding to guarantee schema compliance. Only used when the provider supports
structured outputs and a schema is provided. Defaults to <code>true</code>.</p>
</li>
</ul>

<h2 class="flex scroll-m-28 flex-row items-center gap-2" id="provider-specific-options"><a class="peer" data-card="" href="#provider-specific-options">Provider-specific options</a><svg data-slot="geist-icon" height="16" style="color:var(--ds-gray-900)" viewBox="0 0 16 16" width="16" aria-hidden="true" class="size-3.5 shrink-0 opacity-0 transition-opacity peer-hover:opacity-100"><path clip-rule="evenodd" d="M8.47 1.47a4.29 4.29 0 1 1 6.06 6.06l-2.5 2.5-1.06-1.06 2.5-2.5a2.79 2.79 0 0 0-3.94-3.94l-2.5 2.5-1.06-1.06zm3.06 4.06-6 6-1.06-1.06 6-6zm-10.06 9a4.3 4.3 0 0 0 6.06 0l2.5-2.5-1.06-1.06-2.5 2.5a2.79 2.79 0 0 1-3.94-3.94l2.5-2.5-1.06-1.06-2.5 2.5a4.3 4.3 0 0 0 0 6.06" fill="currentColor" fill-rule="evenodd"></path></svg></h2>
<p>The OpenAI Compatible provider supports adding provider-specific options to the request body. These are specified with the <code>providerOptions</code> field in the request body.</p>
<p>For example, if you create a provider instance with the name <code>providerName</code>, you can add a <code>customOption</code> field to the request body like this:</p>

<p>Note that the <code>providerOptions</code> key will be in camelCase. If you set the provider name to <code>provider-name</code>, the options still need to be set on <code>providerOptions.providerName</code>.</p>
<p>The request body sent to the provider will include the <code>customOption</code> field with the value <code>magic-value</code>. This gives you an easy way to add provider-specific options to requests without having to modify the provider or AI SDK code.</p>
<h2 class="flex scroll-m-28 flex-row items-center gap-2" id="custom-metadata-extraction"><a class="peer" data-card="" href="#custom-metadata-extraction">Custom Metadata Extraction</a><svg data-slot="geist-icon" height="16" style="color:var(--ds-gray-900)" viewBox="0 0 16 16" width="16" aria-hidden="true" class="size-3.5 shrink-0 opacity-0 transition-opacity peer-hover:opacity-100"><path clip-rule="evenodd" d="M8.47 1.47a4.29 4.29 0 1 1 6.06 6.06l-2.5 2.5-1.06-1.06 2.5-2.5a2.79 2.79 0 0 0-3.94-3.94l-2.5 2.5-1.06-1.06zm3.06 4.06-6 6-1.06-1.06 6-6zm-10.06 9a4.3 4.3 0 0 0 6.06 0l2.5-2.5-1.06-1.06-2.5 2.5a2.79 2.79 0 0 1-3.94-3.94l2.5-2.5-1.06-1.06-2.5 2.5a4.3 4.3 0 0 0 0 6.06" fill="currentColor" fill-rule="evenodd"></path></svg></h2>
<p>The OpenAI Compatible provider supports extracting provider-specific metadata from API responses through metadata extractors.
These extractors allow you to capture additional information returned by the provider beyond the standard response format.</p>
<p>Metadata extractors receive the raw, unprocessed response data from the provider, giving you complete flexibility
to extract any custom fields or experimental features that the provider may include.
This is particularly useful when:</p>
<ul>
<li>Working with providers that include non-standard response fields</li>
<li>Experimenting with beta or preview features</li>
<li>Capturing provider-specific metrics or debugging information</li>
<li>Supporting rapid provider API evolution without SDK changes</li>
</ul>
<p>Metadata extractors work with both streaming and non-streaming chat completions and consist of two main components:</p>
<ol>
<li>A function to extract metadata from complete responses</li>
<li>A streaming extractor that can accumulate metadata across chunks in a streaming response</li>
</ol>
<p>Here&#x27;s an example metadata extractor that captures both standard and custom provider data:</p>
